# +MD 15-20mmHg Women's Footless Compression Pantyhose

## Everyday Support for Tired, Achy Legs

Give your legs graduated compression at 15-20 mmHg. These footless pantyhose massage and energize tired legs, so you can feel refreshed after long days on your feet, at your desk, or on the road. They're designed to ease everyday discomfort from fatigue, swelling, and soreness.

## Comfortable for All-Day Wear

Made from a 78.7% nylon and 21.3% elastane blend with a micro-scaled knit pattern, these pantyhose feel soft against your skin from morning to night. The premium stay-up top stays put without leaving marks, and the ideal thickness fits comfortably under any shoe.

## Discreet Style for Any Occasion

Wear them for walking, sitting, standing, or traveling. The sleek design moves easily from casual weekends to work meetings, dress events, and formal occasions.

## Built to Last

Reinforced thighs and waist help these pantyhose hold up to regular wear. They're machine washable, so you can keep them in rotation without special care.

## Add Them to Your Cart

Choose your everyday support today. Consult your healthcare provider before use if you have a medical condition.
